name: Vospominaniya o «Sovyonke»
source:
A story about the relationship between two characters: Semyon and Slavya.

Slavya... For many, she has become a symbol of kindness, care, and help. Many of us dreamed of meeting a girl like that in real life. But how many of us know what Slavya is really like? How did she become the person we know? What are her goals and aspirations? What is she afraid of, and what does she doubt? Does she have any weaknesses? This story tries to answer these questions.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=710779227]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个关于两个人物之间关系的故事：谢苗和斯拉维亚。

Slavya…对于许多人来说，她已经成为善良、关怀和帮助的象征。我们很多人都梦想在现实生活中遇到这样的女孩。但我们中有多少人知道斯拉维亚到底是什么样子呢？她是如何成为我们认识的人的？她的目标和愿望是什么？她在害怕什么，她在怀疑什么？她有什么弱点吗？这个故事试图回答这些问题。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=710779227]Steam[/url]]
